dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct high-contrast white spotting visible as discrete rectangular blocks along the outer edges of the flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Symmetrical lateral rufous-brown patches situated on the posterior sides of the upper neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright red patch on the central crown and bold, high-contrast black-and-white transverse banding across the entire tail surface.
